instruction: Query the OQMD database for elemental Fe (element_set=Fe AND ntypes=1), get the first result, extract name/delta_e/stability/spacegroup, and save to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\oqmd\oqmd_task_2.txt'. Use the OQMD REST API directly with the `requests` library (endpoint: https://oqmd.org/oqmdapi/formationenergy), do NOT use qmpy_rester.
